Bill.BriefDescription: Transferring unclaimed fuel tax refunds to the recreation resource account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the recreation resource account; and amendingRCW 79A.25.070.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 79A.25.070 and 2000 c 11 s 73 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Upon expiration of the time limited by RCW 82.36.330 for claimingof refunds of tax on marine fuel, the state of Washington shall succeedto the right to such refunds. The director of licensing, after takinginto account past and anticipated claims for refunds from and depositsto the marine fuel tax refund account and the costs of carrying out theprovisions of RCW 79A.25.030, shall request the state treasurer totransfer ((monthly from the marine fuel tax refund account an amountequal to the proportion of the moneys in the account representing themotor vehicle fuel tax rate under RCW 82.36.025 in effect on January 1,1990, to the recreation resource account and the remainder to the motorvehicle fund)) the remaining money to the recreation resource account.
